local_provider_description: Authenticate users with an email address and password stored in Obot. No external identity provider required.
local_provider_domains_description: Comma-separated list of email domains that local users may have. Use * to allow any domain.
okta_client_id_setup: Client ID of an Okta API Services app, which Obot uses to fetch each user's groups from the Okta Management API when they sign in.
okta_private_key_setup: PEM-encoded RSA private key of the Okta API Services app.
okta_parameter_unused: Not used: Okta provisions users and groups through SCIM, so Obot no longer calls the Okta Management API. You can remove it, then delete the API Services app in Okta.
provider_only_one: only one authentication provider can be configured at a time. Please deconfigure {provider} first
local_user_exists: a local user with that email already exists
local_not_authenticated: the current user is not authenticated with the local provider
local_no_password_change: the current local user does not require a password change
local_password_completed: password setup has already been completed or the session is no longer valid
local_unavailable: the local auth provider is not available because authentication is disabled
provider_cleanup_pending: authentication provider {provider} is still being deconfigured; wait for cleanup to finish before configuring it again
provider_deconfigure_active: deconfiguring {provider} would leave no way to sign in. Configure a replacement and complete the switch instead
provider_staged_replacement: {provider} is staged as a replacement. Discard the staged switch instead
provider_already_active: {provider} is already the active authentication provider
provider_verify_first: sign in through {provider} to verify it before completing the switch
local_valid_email_required: a valid email address is required
local_email_domain_disallowed: email {email} is not in the provider's allowed email domains
local_initial_owner_role: the initial local account must become Owner; choose an email that is not configured as an Admin through the environment
local_password_must_differ: the new password must be different from your current password
local_setup_token_length: the initial owner setup token must be at least 32 characters
local_initial_owner_domain: initial owner email {email} is not in the local provider's allowed email domains
local_password_min_length: password must be at least {count} characters
local_bootstrap_limit: bootstrap can only create one local account; sign in with the existing account to continue setup
provider_change_in_progress: another provider configuration change is already in progress
setup_no_provider_user_id: no auth provider user ID in context
setup_local_not_configured: local authentication is not the configured provider
setup_no_local_account: no local account exists for setup
setup_sign_in_initial: sign in with the initial local account to continue setup
setup_change_password: change your password before completing setup
setup_email_mismatch: email mismatch: expected {expected} but got {actual} in request
setup_cannot_promote_admin: cannot promote {email} to Owner: the address is configured as an Admin through the environment
local_login_throttled: Too many failed login attempts. Try again later.
local_login_domain_disallowed: This email domain is not allowed to sign in.
github_auth_provider_client_id_descripti: Client ID for your GitHub OAuth app. Can be found in GitHub Developer Settings > OAuth Apps
github_auth_provider_client_secret_descr: Client secret for your GitHub OAuth app. Can be found in GitHub Developer Settings > OAuth Apps
github_auth_provider_cookie_secret_descr: Secret used to encrypt cookies. Must be a random string of length 16, 24, or 32.
github_auth_provider_email_domains_descr: A list of email domains that are allowed to authenticate with this provider. * is a special value that allows all domains.
github_auth_provider_postgres_connection: The connection string for a PostgreSQL database to use for session storage. If unset, cookies will be used for session storage instead.
github_auth_provider_postgres_max_connec: The maximum number of open connections to the PostgreSQL database.
github_auth_provider_postgres_max_idle_c: The maximum number of idle connections to the PostgreSQL database.
github_auth_provider_postgres_connection: The maximum lifetime of a connection to the PostgreSQL database.
github_auth_provider_token_refresh_durat: Time to wait before attempting to refresh auth tokens. Should be in a format like 1h1m1s. Default: 1h
github_auth_provider_org_description: Restrict logins to members of this GitHub organization.
github_auth_provider_allow_users_descrip: A list of GitHub users allowed to log in, even if they do not belong to the specified org.
github_auth_provider_enable_logging_desc: Set to true to enable request, auth, and standard logging for the auth provider. Default: false

jumpcloud_auth_provider_client_secret_de: Client secret for your JumpCloud custom OIDC application.

jumpcloud_auth_provider_service_account_: Client ID for a JumpCloud API service account. Configure this and the matching service account client secret to use service-account authentication instead of an API key.
Client secret for a JumpCloud API service account. Configure this and the matching service account client ID to use service-account authentication instead of an API key.
jumpcloud_auth_provider_api_key_descript: JumpCloud API key used to list groups, inspect user memberships, and verify account status. Use this if you are not using the service-account client ID and client secret above.
jumpcloud_auth_provider_api_org_id_descr: Optional JumpCloud org ID header for multi-tenant API requests.
jumpcloud_auth_provider_issuer_url_descr: JumpCloud OIDC issuer URL. Default: https://oauth.id.jumpcloud.com/
jumpcloud_auth_provider_api_base_url_des: JumpCloud API base URL. Default: https://console.jumpcloud.com. Customers using the EU data center should set this to https://console.eu.jumpcloud.com.
jumpcloud_auth_provider_service_account_: OAuth token endpoint for JumpCloud service-account client-credentials exchanges. Use this with the service account fields above. Default: https://admin-oauth.id.jumpcloud.com/oauth2/token. Override this if your JumpCloud region uses a different admin OAuth endpoint.

jumpcloud_auth_provider_postgres_max_idl: The maximum number of idle connections to the PostgreSQL database.
jumpcloud_auth_provider_postgres_connect: The maximum lifetime of a PostgreSQL database connection, in seconds.
